summary: Cosmic Sleepover 3D is an interactive web based experience aimed at educating school age and casual space enthusiasts about the hardware left across the solar system on the moon, mars and deep space since the 1960s. Rovers, probes, landers and other scientific instruments are awakened by the user followed by learning about the purpose and functionalities of these artifacts left behind. Users can explore 12 NASA spacecraft, interact with their 3D models, discover mission facts, play educational games, test planetary gravity, and participate in quizzes. Enthusiasts can further make a 13th bot by mixing and matching hardware, picking a destination and launching it into space! Our website aims to provide a fun, immersive and memorable experience in learning about spacecrafts.
details:
Project Details: Cosmic Sleepover 3D

Cosmic Sleepover 3D is an interactive, gamified space-learning website that brings NASA spacecraft to life through 3D exploration and storytelling. Users can discover and awaken 12 real NASA spacecraft, represented as friendly Spirit Bots, explore their missions, test planetary gravity, and learn interesting scientific facts.

The platform offers several features, including interactive 3D spacecraft models, cleaning and restoration activities, AI-powered conversations, mission quizzes, voice narration, NASA radio audio, space selfies, and a spacecraft design lab where users can build their own 13th bot. It also includes an achievement system with rewards, certificates, and learning progress tracking.

The project benefits students by making complex scientific concepts easier to understand through visualisation, interaction, and gamification. Its intended impact is to encourage curiosity about astronomy, promote STEM education, and make space science more accessible and enjoyable.

The project is deployed using Vercel and integrates real NASA mission information and NSSDCA catalogue data. Its development involves HTML, CSS, Java, 3D visualisation, interactive programming, and AI-powered features.

The creative aspect lies in transforming real spacecraft into character-based learning companions with unique personalities and stories. Our team considered accessibility, educational value, user engagement, scientific accuracy, ease of navigation, and the overall user experience while developing the platform.
